text: And she went to [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] and she took [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ.
The mother of [[Muhammad|مُحَمَّد]] ﷺ, [[Aminah|آمنة]], agreed to give her child under the care of [[Halimah al-Sa'diyyah|حليمة السعدية]].

Now [[Halimah al-Sa'diyyah|حليمة السعدية]] and her husband [[al-Harith|الحارث]], they started noticing the [[barakah|بركة]], the blessings that came into their life after taking this child immediately.

The donkey that they used to come into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]], it was an old and weak and very slow donkey. So slow that [[Halimah|حليمة]] came into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]] after the rest of the people had already came into [[Makkah|مَكَّة]]. She was late.
